title: ConnectionEvent
description: One line of the history of a server about a client that connects to it: a Studio or Suite session, an app, the voice service or anything else that speaks to the server. It says what happened and who, never how: no password, token, cookie or code is ever in it. The address (ip) and the user agent (agent) are for administrators only; the server removes them from the answer to anybody else.

client_kind.description: What kind of client it is, as it says itself in the X-Hydra-Client header.

client_id.description: A short hash that tells one client from another (kind, user and application); it is not a secret.

two_factor.description: The second factor was asked and answered in this sign-in.
